tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels beside a low wooden bench, pressing both flat palms onto its surface to steady a wobbling stack of ceramic bowls while leaning forward with focused concentration.
tasks.camera: low three-quarter angle from bench height, hands and bowls centered
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands fully visible with all five fingers clearly separated, no occlusion by bowls or bench edge.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在木凳旁，双掌按稳摇晃的瓷碗，展示双手与专注姿态。

tasks.instruction: Seated cross-legged on a woven mat, the blue tiger holds a large ball of blue yarn with both hands spread apart, thumbs hooking the strand as it stretches between its wide-open palms.
tasks.camera: straight-on medium close-up with mat texture visible below
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms facing camera, yarn strand between them, all ten fingers unobstructed.
tasks.intent_zh: 盘腿坐垫上双手撑开毛线，掌心朝前展示手指。

tasks.instruction: Balancing on a single stool, the blue tiger presses one palm flat against the ceiling for support while the other hand gestures downward explaining height, body stretched tall with tail curled.
tasks.camera: wide low-angle upward shot capturing ceiling contact and downward palm
tasks.visibility_requirement: The ceiling palm and the explaining palm both face the camera, fingers distinct and unblocked.
tasks.intent_zh: 踩凳顶撑天花板，另一手掌下压示意高度，双掌清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches inside a cardboard box cut with star-shaped holes, pushing one palm out through each hole with fingers splayed like star points while peering through the flaps.
tasks.camera: front view at box level, star holes and protruding palms framed symmetrically
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms protrude clearly from their holes, all five fingers visible beyond the cardboard edges.
tasks.intent_zh: 躲在纸箱中，双掌从星形孔伸出张开，展示手指。

tasks.instruction: Leaning over a wide glass fish tank, the blue tiger presses both palms flat onto the water surface creating ripples, watching fish scatter below while keeping arms straight.
tasks.camera: overhead high angle looking down at palms on water and fish below
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms on the water visible from above, all fingers spread and unoccluded by reflection glare.
tasks.intent_zh: 俯身双掌按水面激起涟漪，俯拍双手与鱼群。

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a tall ladder rung, the blue tiger reaches both hands upward to clasp a paint roller handle together, guiding it along a wall strip above its head.
tasks.camera: side three-quarter low angle, arms raised and hands gripping handle overhead
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping the roller handle, all fingers wrapped and visible from the side, no wall occlusion.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐梯上双手共握滚筒刷墙，侧角度展示握持手指。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its back beneath a car chassis, both hands raised holding a wrench, one palm steadying a bolt while the other turns, legs bent outside the frame.
tasks.camera: low ground-level side view looking under the car at raised hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands under the chassis clearly visible in the light, fingers on wrench distinct.
tasks.intent_zh: 车底仰躺双手握扳手维修，低角度展示双手。

tasks.instruction: Kneeling at a shallow tide pool, the blue tiger cups both palms together to scoop water and a tiny crab, holding the hands close to its face to inspect the catch.
tasks.camera: close-up over-the-shoulder angle focusing on cupped hands and crab
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both cupped palms visible from above, fingers interlocked and distinct around the crab.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在潮池边双手捧水与小蟹，俯视展示手指。

tasks.instruction: Hanging from a horizontal ceiling bar by both hands, the blue tiger tucks its knees up and swings slightly, fingers hooked over the bar with palms facing away from camera.
tasks.camera: front medium shot slightly below, bar and hooked hands at top of frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping the bar visible, knuckles and wrapped fingers clear against the sky background.
tasks.intent_zh: 双手悬挂天花板横杆收膝摆动，正面展示抓握手指。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches over a patch of wet clay and presses both palms flat into it, leaving deep handprints while looking up at the camera with muddy forearms.
tasks.camera: high angle looking down at clay and flat palms, face tilted up
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat in clay seen from above, all fingers and thumb pads visible and pressed.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲下双掌按压湿泥留下手印，俯拍展示掌面。

tasks.instruction: Standing before a giant chalkboard, the blue tiger presses one palm flat against the board for balance while the other hand draws a large spiral with chalk, body leaning in.
tasks.camera: three-quarter side view with chalkboard filling background
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands on the board visible, flat support palm and chalk-holding fingers distinct.
tasks.intent_zh: 站黑板前一手撑板一手画螺旋，展示双掌。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a floating wooden raft, both palms pressed together in a tight prayer-like clap while wind blows its fur, eyes squeezed shut against spray.
tasks.camera: close frontal shot on the raft, sea spray and palms centered
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms pressed together facing camera, all fingers aligned and clearly separable.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐木筏双掌合十闭眼迎风，正面展示合掌手指。

tasks.instruction: Leaning out a second-story window, the blue tiger stretches both hands down to catch a falling bouquet, fingers spread wide like a basket below the sill.
tasks.camera: low angle from street looking up at the window and spread hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands extend beyond the sill, palms open downward, all fingers against the sky.
tasks.intent_zh: 探窗向下双手张成篮状接花束，仰拍双掌。

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a swing, the blue tiger holds both palms up to catch a tossed apple, eyes tracking it, fingers spread and slightly curved in anticipation.
tasks.camera: medium frontal shot with swing ropes framing the raised hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both raised palms face camera, apple above them, all fingers distinct and unblocked.
tasks.intent_zh: 荡秋千时双手上举准备接苹果，正面展示张开手指。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger straddles a narrow rooftop ridge, both palms flat on the tiles behind it for support while looking down the slope with tense posture.
tasks.camera: high oblique angle from above and behind, palms on tiles visible
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat on the tiles behind the body, fingers spread and clearly visible from above.
tasks.intent_zh: 跨坐屋顶双手后撑瓦片，俯后角度展示双掌。

tasks.instruction: Crouched low behind a snow wall, the blue tiger pokes both palms over the top edge with fingers curled, mimicking a stealthy peek while snow dusts its ears.
tasks.camera: front low angle with snow wall edge cutting across hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands curl over the snow wall, all fingers visible above the edge, palms partly turned toward camera.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲雪墙后双手扒边探头，低角度展示手指。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels beside a large drum, striking it with alternating flat palms, both hands caught mid-motion above the taut skin with fingers spread.
tasks.camera: side view at drum level, both raised palms visible against the drumhead
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms raised above the drum, fingers splayed and distinct, no motion blur hiding digits.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在鼓旁双掌交替击鼓，侧面展示张开手掌。

tasks.instruction: Holding a heavy watering can overhead, the blue tiger uses both palms to tip it, water pouring onto tall plants, arms raised and elbows locked.
tasks.camera: low upward angle from plant level at the raised hands and can
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands on the can above the head visible, all fingers around the handle and base distinct.
tasks.intent_zh: 双手举高浇水壶倒水，仰拍展示握持手指。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits cross-legged threading a needle, both palms close together holding a tiny needle and bright thread, squinting with tongue out in concentration.
tasks.camera: tight close-up on hands and face, needle between palms centered
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands framing the needle visible, thumb and index fingers pinching, remaining fingers spread and clear.
tasks.intent_zh: 盘腿穿针，双掌夹针捏线，特写展示手指动作。

tasks.instruction: Leaning against a tall bookshelf, the blue tiger holds a heavy atlas with both palms flat underneath, arms trembling slightly, looking over the top edge.
tasks.camera: front medium shot with shelf lines behind and palms under the book
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms support the book underside, fingers spread beneath it and visible from front.
tasks.intent_zh: 靠书架双手平托厚重地图册，正面展示掌下手指。

tasks.instruction: Perched on a boulder above a stream, the blue tiger leans down and presses both palms into the rushing water, fingers parting the current as spray hits its chest.
tasks.camera: low side angle from water level looking up at boulder and pressing palms
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms pressed into the stream visible, fingers spread against the current, no spray obscuring digits.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲巨石双掌压入溪流分开水流，低角度展示手指。

tasks.instruction: Lying prone on a skateboard, the blue tiger pushes both palms against the ground to roll forward, arms extended and fingers splayed on the pavement.
tasks.camera: low trailing angle from behind, palms on pavement and board nose in frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat on pavement visible from behind and low, fingers spread and unblocked by the board.
tasks.intent_zh: 趴在滑板上双掌撑地推行，低后角度展示双掌。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stands inside a large bubble wand hoop, pressing both palms outward against an emerging soap film, rainbow swirls around its spread fingers.
tasks.camera: frontal close shot with bubble film filling frame around hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms press the soap film facing camera, all fingers visible through the transparent film edge.
tasks.intent_zh: 站在泡泡圈内双掌推肥皂膜，正面展示掌指与彩虹。

tasks.instruction: With one knee on a floating log, the blue tiger uses both palms to paddle the water like oars on either side, leaning forward with ears back.
tasks.camera: high front angle looking down at palms entering water on both sides
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paddling palms visible above and in water, fingers spread and distinct on each side of the log.
tasks.intent_zh: 单膝跪浮木双掌划水，俯前角度展示两侧手掌。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches beneath a low cave ceiling, pushing both palms flat upward against the rock to test its stability, dust falling around its arms.
tasks.camera: low upward angle from the floor, palms flat on ceiling rock overhead
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms press the cave ceiling, fingers spread and visible from below, no rock shadow hiding digits.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲洞中双掌上推岩顶试探稳固，仰拍展示双掌。

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a porch step, the blue tiger holds a large orange between both palms and peels it, fingers digging into the rind with concentrated expression.
tasks.camera: close front view at hand level with orange centered and step below
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands on the orange visible, all fingers wrapped and peeling, thumbs distinct.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐台阶双手剥橙子，正面特写展示手指抓握。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans backward over a balcony railing, both palms gripping the top rail behind it, body arched as it looks at the sky upside down.
tasks.camera: side low angle showing arched body and both hands on railing
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping the railing visible from the side, fingers wrapped and distinct on the rail.
tasks.intent_zh: 后仰靠阳台栏杆双手反握，侧低角度展示抓握手指。

tasks.instruction: Kneeling in tall grass, the blue tiger cups both palms around a glowing firefly, peering into the small cage of fingers with wonder in its eyes.
tasks.camera: close intimate front shot with dark background and glowing hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both cupped palms visible from front, fingers loosely interlaced with gaps showing the glow and each digit.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪草丛双手捧萤火虫，正面特写展示掌间手指与光。

tasks.instruction: Standing at a potter's wheel, the blue tiger presses both palms around a spinning clay bowl, fingers shaping the rim as wet clay splatters its apron.
tasks.camera: overhead three-quarter angle looking down at hands and spinning bowl
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands on the spinning clay visible from above, fingers curved and distinct around the rim.
tasks.intent_zh: 站陶轮旁双掌塑形旋转陶碗，俯拍展示手指。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger balances on a slackline, holding a long balancing pole with both palms flat underneath it, arms extended sideways like wings.
tasks.camera: frontal wide shot with slackline and horizontal pole spanning the frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat under the pole visible, fingers spread and distinct on each side of the body.
tasks.intent_zh: 走扁带双手平托平衡杆，正面展示展开双掌。

tasks.instruction: Crouched in a sandbox, the blue tiger pats a tall sandcastle with both flat palms, packing the walls while looking proudly at the tilted towers.
tasks.camera: low angle from sand level with castle rising and flat palms on its sides
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both flat palms on the sandcastle walls visible, all fingers pressed and distinct.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲沙坑双掌拍实沙堡，低角度展示按压手掌。
